item.title: Do teams still use scrum and sprints?
item.summary: I have been out of the software development system for many years now but I can remember how awful scrum and sprints were, like a race to see who could write the worst possible software. Recently I heard the term again and wondered if it was still a thing? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49422350 Points: 3 # Comments: 10
